name: GCP
purpose: GCP solves the problem of managing complex on-premises IT infrastructure by offering remotely hosted, on-demand computing resources. It enables businesses to innovate faster, scale resources efficiently, reduce operational burden, and leverage advanced technologies like AI and data analytics without heavy upfront investments.
coreComponents: Compute Services (e.g., Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, App Engine)
Storage and Databases (e.g., Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, BigQuery)
Networking Services (e.g., Virtual Private Cloud, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud CDN)
Data Analytics and Machine Learning (e.g., BigQuery, Vertex AI, Cloud AI Platform)
Identity and Security (e.g., Identity and Access Management, Cloud Security Command Center)
keyCapabilities: Global, scalable, and highly available infrastructure
Robust data analytics and machine learning capabilities
Flexible compute options including Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and serverless environments
Comprehensive security and identity management features
Support for hybrid and multi-cloud solutions, often facilitated by Anthos
integrations: Third-party SaaS applications and enterprise applications like Salesforce
On-premises infrastructure for hybrid cloud deployments
Other cloud service providers (e.g., AWS, Azure) for multi-cloud strategies
Developer tools and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Cloud Build, GitHub)
Monitoring and observability platforms (e.g., New Relic, LogicMonitor)
useCases: Web and mobile application development and hosting
Large-scale data analytics, warehousing, and real-time insights with services like BigQuery
Machine learning model training, deployment, and generative AI solutions
Lift-and-shift migrations of enterprise databases and legacy applications from on-premises infrastructure
Building real-time intelligence platforms and event-driven architectures
